## What happened?

Describe expected and observed behavior. For sensitive findings, use SECURITY.md instead of a public issue.

## Reproduce

Provide the repository revision, affected skill/helper, client or engine versions, minimal sanitized inputs and exact command or request.

## Evidence

Attach relevant output and distinguish actual observations from interpretation. Use synthetic models; omit credentials and confidential captures.

## Checks and workaround

Which checks ran? What failed, was skipped or remains unknown?
